body:
Looks like a class loader issue.

And there's a good chance it will break code.quarkus.io on upgrade so we really need a fix.
I can take a look if needed (although not excited about what does look like a ClassLoader issue :))
@geoand I'll have a look and let u know if I have troobles ;-)

> What Quarkus version?

master, see reproducer command

I probably added that Spring thing but I have no recollection of it 😂

On Tue, Feb 25, 2020, 14:00 Andy Damevin <notifications@github.com> wrote:

> Looking in the code, I found a similar case for Spring which seems fixed
> by BlacklistedServletContainerInitializerBuildItem. Added this code to
> the Sentry recorder which fix the bug.
>
>  @BuildStep
>     public BlacklistedServletContainerInitializerBuildItem blacklistServlet() {
>         return new BlacklistedServletContainerInitializerBuildItem("io.sentry.servlet.SentryServletContainerInitializer");
>     }
>
> I think this is a good thing at the end because we had no control over
> this SentryServletContainerInitializer which was always enabled. Now I
> need a way to add our own sentry servlet initializer managed by us to
> replace it :)
>
> —
> You are receiving this because you were mentioned.
> Reply to this email directly, view it on GitHub
> <https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/7407?email_source=notifications&email_token=ABBMDP2TXZQ3FYI3DXTCS3LREUB4TA5CNFSM4K3BPYT2YY3PNVWWK3TUL52HS4DFVREXG43VMVBW63LNMVXHJKTDN5WW2ZLOORPWSZGOEM3WGFY#issuecomment-590832407>,
> or unsubscribe
> <https://github.com/notifications/unsubscribe-auth/ABBMDP72W5GHVUVCPZPJEBTREUB4TANCNFSM4K3BPYTQ>
> .
>

@stuartwdouglas I haven't found a good solution without reimplementing Sentry. I don't know why the app classloader doesn't include the `ServletRequestListener`. I've excluded `javax.servlet-api` to be sure it wasn't a conflict.

FYI this is a blocking problem since code.quarkus.io uses Undertow and Sentry together.

issue.title: Load the Servlet API parent first
